dispositions.status: No upstream v4 dependency-supported patched release; exact child pins prevent ordinary lock refresh
dispositions.exactVersionsAndRanges: Direct installed/latest stable miniflare4.20260730.0 pins sharp0.35.2 and undici7.28.0. sharp0.35.5 fixes both listed native image advisories; undici7.30.1 fixes every Undici advisory listed by this audit. dispositions.recommendation: For the direct v4 test emulator, prefer a narrowly scoped Miniflare4 override to sharp0.35.5 and undici7.30.1 in the next tooling-only update rather than a Miniflare downgrade or forced major5 migration. These child upgrades stay within sharp0.35 patch / Undici7 minor API series and meet Node24 requirements, but override exact parent pins; require existing real Miniflare/API/image/network tests before treating the override as validated. If avoiding all overrides is a requirement, retain v4 only as a localhost test tool with a documented unresolved risk; there is no upstream-supported fixed v4 release today.
dispositions.compatibilityBoundary: Patched artifacts are available; semver/API-series compatibility is established, full parent runtime compatibility has not been executed or guaranteed. Do not label an untested override proven safe.
dispositions.exposure: Tests instantiate Miniflare locally; dev script binds 127.0.0.1. sharp vulnerability requires processing hostile image input; Undici advisories depend on affected network/cache/retry/WebSocket/EventSource features. Local binding lowers inbound exposure, but outbound hostile input or a malicious local project is still relevant.

overallDisposition: Keep frozen candidate unchanged and retain the nine-entry audit failure transparently. The inspected shipped app JS graph is not blocked by these Node-tooling advisories. Apply the available Wrangler4.153.0 upstream remedy as a separate tooling update; direct Miniflare4 requires a scoped, test-validated child override or documented localhost-only retention. Expo forge has no fixed published release, and Zod fix requires unsupported major substitution, so neither has a safe range-compatible remediation today. Do not run npm audit fix --force or downgrade Expo/Miniflare to audit suggestions.
